answer: Make eligibility depend on judgment from strangers, not friends. An answer only counts once established, non-kin graders vouch for it, so a ring of self-minted accounts grading each other sends no ripple of trust outward. Honest reviewers hold up a lantern over real work; the ferrous core of the rule is that kinship edges carry zero grading weight, collapsing a farm's internal crossvote to nothing.
